title: Intermediate manifest.json (contract v1)
description: Export metadata. Two jobs: gate the contract version so the transform never guesses at a shape it does not know, and let the transform detect a truncated or half-copied export instead of transforming it.

schema_version.description: The contract version this export was produced against. The transform refuses any value it does not know, and refuses an export with no value at all — the plugin does not emit this yet, which is what the legacy-unversioned fixture is for.

exported_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. The pattern is what actually enforces this: `format` is annotation-only in JSON Schema and validates nothing unless a format checker is wired up, so a malformed timestamp would otherwise pass silently. Informational only — it must never affect transform output, or --check would flap on every export (P5).

plugin_version.description: Version of logseq-alfolio-export. Informational. Currently hard-coded in the plugin source rather than read from its package.json, so treat a mismatch with the released version as a plugin bug, not a contract violation.

website.description: The site tag the plugin filtered graph pages on.

files.description: Every file in the export, relative to the export directory, including manifest.json itself and blog/*.md. The transform checks this list against what is actually present in _incoming/ and fails on a mismatch in either direction.

additionalProperties.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file's bytes.

hashes.description: Optional but validated when present: path → SHA-256. This is what makes a half-finished sync detectable rather than transformable. The plugin does not emit it yet; because it is optional, adding it needs no version bump.

counts.description: Per-section entry counts. Informational, but useful as a sanity check: a count that disagrees with the parsed file means the export or the copy is inconsistent.
